oldRow.note: Longest continuous stretch of net discharge above 130 km/h (an observed run maximum, not a limit set by the SoC floor; read beside cumulative 130+ km/h exposure). Set on: highway · peak 157 km/h · SoC 59.0-80.0%.

newRun.note: Longest contiguous run of net discharge above 130 km/h, taken from the per-drive run column (capped timeline steps are summed across log gaps, so a gap does not break a run and the value can overstate it). An observed run maximum: not a limit set by the SoC floor and not evidence that the SoC floor forced a speed compromise. Cumulative exposure is a separate row below. Set on: mixed-highway · peak 170 km/h · SoC 51.5-78.0%.

newCumulative.note: Largest total time in one drive spent in net discharge above 130 km/h, added up across separate stretches (cumulative exposure, not a continuous run). Read beside the contiguous-run row above. Set on: highway · peak 157 km/h · SoC 59.0-80.0%.

highSpeedCensus130.definition: longest continuous streak above 130 km/h irrespective of discharge state

definitionComparison.note: three definitions disagree by construction (run column: net-discharge only, capped steps summed across gaps; census: any state); reported, not tuned

old.note: Hottest cabin-sourced cooling air presented to the pack inlet. The floor the pack can be cooled to: forced convection cannot pull cells below their own intake, so this bounds the achievable pack minimum on a hot day. Set on: urban · 5.7 km / 16 min · pack mean 40°C.

new.note: Highest single native sample of the intake-air temperature channel presented to the pack inlet (row-level maximum over the drive logs, the same native-sample basis as the minimum row; valid range -40 to 80 °C; a drive whose maximum exceeds 80 °C is excluded whole). The channel has been unavailable since 2026-08-24 (M319). Set on: urban · 5.7 km / 16 min · pack mean 40°C.

newDisclosure.eligibilityRule: sanity cap: intake_max_raw <= 80 C (physical-plausibility bound on intake-air temperature (native samples, battery_temp_extremes.csv))
newDisclosure.excludedNote: 13 drive(s) with intake_max_raw up to 107.0 C excluded as out-of-range artefacts (> 80 C cap); the reported record is the max of the in-range values.
newDisclosure.capAppliesTo: each drive's native maximum: a drive whose maximum exceeds the cap is excluded whole
